mapper.select: SELECT FACTORY_CODE, AREA, ORI_MATERIAL_CODE, SUM(ORD_QTY) AS ORD_QTY FROM T_DP_SALES_ORDER_POOL WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND BILL_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{billDateStartTime}, ' 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AND BILL_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{billDateStartTime}, ' 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') GROUP BY FACTORY_CODE, AREA, ORI_MATERIAL_CODE
